summary.scope: Generic GPU entries receive explicitly named partner cards only when chip and memory agree. Exact named retail records receive their own model. Existing retained photos keep prior provenance; their appearance was reviewed but new manufacturer downloads were not performed for every retained record. A final local follow-up added 11 previously hidden retained photographs using preserved provenance; existing source checks remain undated where no date was recorded. The original 103 entries were unchanged.
